messages:
riley: Heads-up — hosted-api integration smoke is red on CI. 5 failing tests on shard 14 for PR #4213. Failing: auth-handshake, stream-toolcall-schema, stream-connection-timeout x2.

matt: thanks, can you paste the failing log snippets? which suite exactly?

riley: suite=hosted-api-smoke, job=integration-shard-14. Log excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-17T12:04:21Z] ERROR auth: handshake failed: missing header 'x-rdw-session' (status 401)
[2026-03-17T12:04:22Z] ERROR stream: toolcall schema validation error: tool 'weather' missing required property 'inputs'
[2026-03-17T12:04:22Z] ERROR stream: connection closed after 2s, upstream EOF
```

jun: odd — I ran a quick local smoke against the hosted staging endpoint and saw the auth header rotated out (session cookie TTL). Could be token rotation/refresh. PR #4213 touched auth-proxy header parsing last week.

sana: tagging @matt and @jun — can we rerun just shard 14 to rule out flake? ci-bot, please rerun integration-shard-14 for PR #4213.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by sana. Queueing job integration-shard-14 (PR 4213). Estimated start in ~30s. :gear:

matt: while that runs — quick repro steps if you want to test locally: 
```bash
# exchange session token then hit streaming endpoint
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SESSION_TOKEN" \
  -H "x-rdw-session: $SESSION_ID" \
  -N "https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/stream?model=redwood-alpha"
```
Look for schema validation lines in the runtime logs.

qa-bot: Rerun done — shard 14 results: 3 failures remain (same signatures). Two flakes passed. Full logs uploaded: https://ci.internal/runs/2109876543/shard14/logs

riley: grabbing the logs now. Notably the tool schema error shows the payload from the tool broker doesn't include 'inputs' field for the weather tool. That broker was upgraded yesterday (broker v2.1.0) in infra rollout.

jun: OK that points to broker change. The auth-handshake 401s coincide with session header parsing change in auth-proxy PR 4198 (deployed last night). Could be two separate regressions.

matt: quick triage plan: 1) pin tool-broker to v2.0.8 in the test env and rerun smoke, 2) revert auth-proxy header parsing change in staging or enable legacy-header fallback, 3) if green, backport hotfix to staging. Who can flip the pin?

ops-bot: I can toggle broker version in the test deployment. Confirming pin to v2.0.8 for hosted-stage now.

riley: thanks — doing an env-based replay after broker pin.

(5m later)

ops-bot: Broker pin applied: hosted-stage tool-broker -> v2.0.8.

qa-bot: Re-running hosted-api-smoke on shard 14 after broker pin... queued.

qa-bot: Results: broker pin removed the toolcall schema failures. Remaining failures: auth-handshake 401 x3.

jun: so broker was one regression. Auth issues still present — likely auth-proxy PR 4198. I can flip the legacy-header fallback flag to true for staging to validate.

sana: please do that and re-run the smoke. If that fixes it we can ship a small revert/hotfix for auth-proxy.

jun: toggled legacy-header-fallback=true in staging via feature flag (ff-auth-legacy).

ci-bot: queued rerun: hosted-api-smoke shard 14 (after ff change).

qa-bot: All tests green on shard 14 now. Full run: https://ci.internal/runs/2109876543/shard14/summary — tool schema + auth handshake green.

matt: good work. Action items: 
- jun: open hotfix PR to revert problematic header parsing in auth-proxy (or add safer parsing). Link PR here.
- riley: monitor prod deploys for auth-proxy and broker, add canary rule for schema mismatch alerts.
- sana: coordinate postmortem once hotfix lands, include timeline and rollback steps.

jun: filing hotfix PR now -> https://git.internal/redwood/auth-proxy/pulls/4220 - it reintroduces legacy parsing and adds stricter tests for session headers.

riley: marking this thread as triaged — thanks team. I'll keep an eye on the staged runs and ping if anything flares. :white_check_mark:

sana: adding a short incident note in #incidents and scheduling a 15-min sync at 16:00 to review root cause and release plan.

ops-bot: Deployed hotfix candidate to staging for verification if CI remains green.

matt: moving to close loop — please update PR with backport plan. I’ll follow up on the postmortem doc.

riley: closing thread for now, reopen if we see recurrence.
